instr: Connect the circles: click the circles in the right order as quickly as you can.
clue: Click or tap the circles in order as quickly as you can (keyboard: Tab to a circle, then Enter). If the circles hold only numbers, go 1-2-3-4 and so on. If they hold numbers and letters, alternate: 1-J-2-K-3-L and so on. A wrong circle flashes red; then find the right one. The circles appear when you press Start.
